translations.web: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
translations.bsb: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
translations.kjv: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
